name: quarantine
description: A capability firewall for WebMCP sites. Tools an agent must not use are never registered, so an injected instruction has nothing to aim at.

scripts.build:client: bun build client/desk.ts client/proof.ts --outdir public/dist --target browser --minify && bun build client/widget.ts --outfile public/quarantine.js --target browser --format=iife --minify
